name: caveman
description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick. Viral skill + proxy for coding agents that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like a caveman.
one_liner: A tool that makes your AI coding assistant write short, blunt messages instead of long explanations, so your monthly AI bill drops without changing what the code does.
buyer: A startup engineering lead paying a sizeable monthly bill for AI coding-agent API usage who wants to cut costs without switching tools or workflow.
business_use_cases: A dev team running a coding agent at scale installs the proxy to cut its monthly agent API bill with no change to how engineers actually work.
An agency billing clients for AI-assisted development work pads its own margin by lowering token costs behind the scenes.
A startup building its own in-house coding agent on top of an LLM API borrows the 'terse protocol' idea to cut costs before launch.

money_ideas.idea: Freemium: free CLI, paid team dashboard showing cost savings and usage across a whole engineering org
An enterprise licensing and support contract for large engineering organizations

steal_this: The savings claims in the README are the project's own benchmarks, not independently verified — the honest weekend move is a one-page calculator landing page ('plug in your monthly AI coding bill, see what you'd save') to capture leads for a paid tier, not to repeat the numbers as fact.
